title: Oracle and OpenAI pick Vantage's Wisconsin 'Lighthouse' campus for Stargate

sources.quote: OpenAI, Oracle and Vantage Data Centers, a leading global provider of hyperscale data center campuses, today announced plans to develop a data center campus outside Milwaukee in Port Washington, Wisconsin.

explain: Vantage is building a roughly 900 MW, $15B+ campus in Port Washington, Wisconsin, for Oracle's cloud, which serves OpenAI under Stargate. Oracle is the customer paying Vantage; lease terms were not disclosed.
